reference.title: Opc Ua Reference
reference.shortdesc: The following topics provide conceptual information on the OPC UA security architecture, including descriptions of the security policies, security mode, security profiles and user authentication.

section.p: Also covered is information on point type and facet mapping, server alarm processing and alarm acknowledgment processing, links for third-party simulation software, as well as descriptions of the components and views present in the opcUaServer and opcUaClient modules.
